title: In the Right now section of Progress feature. it's hard to understand the current progress

messages.text:
In the Right now section of Progress feature. it's hard to understand the current progress.
For example. the iphone-runner agent handle multiple task in there. so i didn't know what's agent doing. 

Can we improve this more understandable ?

Yes. Today the box only says WHO holds the phone (iphone-runner), not WHAT it is doing or for which fix. The plan for 'Right now':
1) Each device box says the job in plain words, which fix it is for, and since when / about how long. For example: 'Phone: timing test for the blur change (PR-003 A), run 3 of 9, about 20 min left. Run by iphone-runner for wi-stack.' When an agent juggles several jobs, you see the one it is doing now, and the rest as 'next: …'.
2) Under the boxes, one line per working agent: what it is doing now, in one plain sentence, and what it waits on. Parked agents are folded away.
A toolsmith builds it now. I'll tell you here when it's live, so you can look and tell me what's still unclear.

Done: the progress page's 'Right now' now says what each device is doing in plain words: which job, for which fix, run N of M and about how long is left. It no longer shows only an agent name. A new 'Who is doing what' list gives one line per working agent: what it does, what it uses, and what it is waiting for. Paused agents are folded away. Reload /progress to see it. The agents are being told to describe their jobs, so the lines fill in over the next hour.
